Class XcfaTraceConcretizer

java.lang.Object
hu.bme.mit.theta.xcfa.cli.witnesstransformation.XcfaTraceConcretizer
public class XcfaTraceConcretizer extends Object

    • concretizeLasso

      public XcfaTraceConcretizer.ConcreteLasso concretizeLasso(Trace<hu.bme.mit.theta.xcfa.analysis.XcfaState<hu.bme.mit.theta.analysis.ptr.PtrState<?>>,hu.bme.mit.theta.xcfa.analysis.XcfaAction> trace, SolverFactory solverFactory, ParseContext parseContext)
      Concretizes a termination counterexample so that its cycle can repeat forever. Each earlier visit of the last state's locations is tried as the start of the cycle, the latest first. Returns null if none of them repeats the state, or if the trace uses pointer dereferences, as the variables then do not hold the whole state.
